option.name: --expiredate
tip: Set the date or number of days since January 1, 1970 on which the user's account will no longer be accessible.
The date may also be expressed in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
Passing -1 removes an account expiration date.

option.name: --inactive
tip: Set password inactive after expiration to INACTIVE.

option.name: --lastday
tip: Set the number of days since January 1, 1970 when the password was last changed.
The date may also be expressed in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
A value of 0 forces the user to change the password on the next log on.

option.name: --maxdays
tip: Set the maximum number of days before password change to MAX_DAYS.

option.name: --mindays
tip: Set the minimum number of days before password change to MIN_DAYS.

option.name: --prefix
tip: Apply changes to configuration files under the root filesystem found under PREFIX_DIR.
This option does not chroot and is intended for preparing a cross-compilation target.

option.name: --root
tip: Apply changes in the CHROOT_DIR directory and use the configuration files from the CHROOT_DIR directory.

option.name: --warndays
tip: Set expiration warning days to WARN_DAYS.
